name: touch-chord
description: Touch Chord: static site (no build). package.json only for the tests.

scripts.test: npm run check-version && npm run test:unit && npm run test:smoke
scripts.cap:sync: node tools/stage-capacitor-www.mjs && cap sync android && node tools/mark-android-wip.mjs
scripts.android:assembleDebug: node tools/stage-capacitor-www.mjs && cap sync android && node tools/mark-android-wip.mjs && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon
